newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai police seize fake passports in scam.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai police seize fake passports in scam.

text.p: Shanghai police have arrested 12 people trying to leave China illegally and seized 18 false passports, the Liberation Daily said on Saturday.
Shanghai police learned in mid-October of attempts to migrate illegally through Shanghai from the southeast province of Fujian and started an investigation, it said.
On October 17, the police burst into a room in a Shanghai hotel and arrested the 12, including the organiser, it said.

The organiser was the general manager of a company that had fallen into debt. He himself planned to escape and had arranged all the fake documents, including Hong Kong and Taiwan identity papers and foreign passports, it said, giving no more details.
